result.reason: The redline appropriately gives Customer a 30-day non-renewal/termination right while preserving the annual renewal structure and unrelated termination provisions. However, it does not include the required price-increase cap of 5% or less, so it fails even the fallback position. It also omits the 60-day renewal reminder required by the preferred position, and the phrase “elect not to renew ... upon thirty (30) days written notice” would be clearer if expressly tied to the applicable renewal date.
